claim: Tiruppur district as officially constituted: formed by G.O. 617/618 (Revenue) of 24-10-2008 from Coimbatore and Erode districts; Census 2011 lists 7 taluks (Kangeyam, Dharapuram, Avanashi, Tiruppur, Palladam, Udumalaipettai, Madathukulam); the district's own map gives area 5087.26 sq km (Census DCHB table: 5,187.00 sq km).

evidence.quote: As per G.O Ms. No. 617, 618 Revenue dated 24.10.2008, Government of Tamil Nadu, the four taluks from Coimbatore district (i.e. Tiruppur, Udumalpet, Palladam and Avinashi(Part)) and three taluks from Erode districts (i.e.Dharapuram, Kangeyam and Perundurai (Part)) were bifurcated and formed another new district, Tiruppur.
There are 7 Taluks, 13 Community Development Blocks, and 297 Revenue Villages in the

notes: This verifies the district's legal basis, taluk list and area only; it does NOT verify the drawn outline in shared/geo/india_districts.js. Official district map (S204) is a 1-page image PDF (no vector, no coordinates, marked FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY). A check is possible: georeference that image (4+ named towns/taluk HQs as control points) and overlay on the drawn polygon, then compare area (the two official areas differ: 5087.26 vs 5187.00, so expect a ~2% tolerance) and the neighbours Erode/Karur/Dindigul/Coimbatore. No gazette text of G.O. 617 found online and no Survey of India sheet consulted. Taluk boundaries changed later (Census shows 7 taluks; district site now lists 9: Uthukuli and Tiruppur North/South added by G.O. 499 of 24-12-2009 and G.O. (M.S) 290/2012 per map title block - the map header lists these GOs, not what each did). Proposed wording on screen: 'Tiruppur district (formed 2008; boundary schematic, community data)' until overlay done; if overlay passes: 'Tiruppur district as of Census 2011 (7 taluks)'. Map gate G9 stays OPEN until overlay is done.

claim: NTADCL's water scheme runs between places its owner names: intake (head works) at Anainasuvampalayam village on the Cauvery near its confluence with the Bhavani; treatment plant at Suriyampalayam village, 1.5 km from the head works; a booster pumping station at Thiruvachi; and the Master Balancing Reservoir at Tirupur.

evidence.quote: Head Works (River Water Intake) is established at Anainasuvampalayam Village
Water Treatment Plant (WTP) is constructed at Suriyampalayam Village which is 1.5 Kms. away from the Head Works.
In between Booster Pumping Station is established at Thiruvachi considering topography of terrain.
to Master Balancing Reservoir (MBR) at Tirupur which is about 53.5 Kms. from WTP.

notes: Place NAMES only; the page gives no coordinates, and no TWAD/TN government document found that does. Same page also says 'Water Treatment Plant (WTP) is located at Bhavani -Near Vasavi college, Erode.' - an internal inconsistency in the owner's text (Suriyampalayam village vs near Vasavi college, Bhavani); do not pin the plant more precisely than 'near Bhavani, Erode district'. The pipeline's actual route is not published; owner is an interested party. Proposed map wording: 'route illustrative between named places' (Bhavani area -> Thiruvachi -> Tiruppur), no coordinates claimed; pins placed by our own geocoding of village names must be tagged artistic/approximate.

claim: NTADCL says the Master Balancing Reservoir at Tirupur is about 53.5 km from the water treatment plant.

evidence.quote: to Master Balancing Reservoir (MBR) at Tirupur which is about 53.5 Kms. from WTP.

notes: Confirmed on the owner's page, second independent fetch. Attribute to NTADCL ('about 53.5 km from the plant'); distance is plant-to-reservoir, not intake-to-reservoir (add 1.5 km head works to WTP if intake is meant, but that is our arithmetic, not stated as total). Rule 2.2 asks for our own measurement; no coordinates exist, so none possible beyond straight-line between geocoded villages (not a pipeline length).

claim: Date of Tiruppur's first knitwear unit, as attributed: 1925 per the Tiruppur Exporters' Association (own About page); 1935 per the Textile Commissioner's note (first hand-operated hosiery factory); 1937 per UNIDO case study (Gulam Kadar, Baby Knitting Industries).

evidence.locator: About TEA, Chronological growth of Tirupur
evidence.quote: The first knitwear unit in Tirupur was set up in 1925 and the growth of the industry was slow till late 1930s.

notes: 1925 now seen in TEA's own words (trade body, interested party, no source given on the page). The 1935 and 1937 evidence stays in C028 and C029. Madras/Coimbatore Gazetteer, SIHMA and Chari's text not reachable; search found only secondary retellings (a Japanese academic paper naming Azad Knitting Co. 1925 and citing Chari 2004 - not opened, not used). The Harvard ISC 1925 sentence (C027) is probably copied from TEA, so not independent corroboration. Say: 'TEA dates the first unit to 1925; official notes say 1935 and 1937' - never one flat date. Replaces C027 (also drops it as spine-sole-source).

claim: TEA's About page says the Tiruppur knitwear sector employs 'Six Lakh Workers directly' (and 'Two Lakh workers indirectly').

evidence.quote: Tirupur Knitwear sector employs Six Lakh Workers directly, out of this, 65% are semi-literate women workers hailing from rural areas and Two Lakh workers indirectly.

notes: Seen in both captures (Dec 2024 and Jun 2026). Attribute to TEA: 'TEA says six lakh'. The page has no 'about' and gives no source/date for the count. Gate G1 satisfied for the attributed claim only.

claim: TEA's About page (June 2026 capture) table: FY25 (2024-25) Tiruppur knitwear exports Rs 44,747 crore vs all-India Rs 65,178 crore, share 68.65%; FY24 38,408 / 55,798 (68.83%).
notes: Attribute to TEA. Same page is internally inconsistent: USD table gives FY25 share 60.77% (Tiruppur 4,682 vs all-India 5,701 US$ mn - quote: 'Share (%) 52.8 55.0 55.6 55.0 60.77 61.00'), sentence says 'In 2024-25, Tiruppur Knitwear exports recorded Rs. 44,747 Crore with a share of 68%', and older text on the page still says 'about 55%'. The Dec 2024 capture (S202) had different, lower figures (e.g. FY22 33,525; FY25 Apr-Aug 55.0%), so TEA revised its series between captures. Also replaces C072 partly (FY22-FY25 values now seen). Use 'about two-thirds by TEA's own rupee table' and flag the 55%/61% conflict; do not state 68.65% as settled fact. Quotes are page-text extractions with '-->' artefacts from table markup.
